tex_content.html:
Lemma
[The homotopy extension property is preserved by products with $I$]

↗ def:homotopy-extension-property

\group CW Complexes

If $(X,A)$ has HEP, then $(X\times I,A\times I)$ has HEP.

Proof

\sketch Use the exponential correspondence between maps $X\times I\times I\to Y$ and maps $X\times I\to C(I,Y)$. The extension problem for $(X\times I,A\times I)$ is the HEP extension problem for $(X,A)$ with target $C(I,Y)$, and evaluation recovers the required extension.

□
